groups.title: Orders
groups.description: Placing, changing and tracking an order.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Add the pieces you like to your bag, open the bag from the header and choose Checkout. You can order as a guest or sign in first — signing in keeps your addresses and order history in one place.

items.question: Can I change or cancel an order after placing it?
items.answer: Orders can be changed or cancelled until they are packed, usually within a few hours. Send us a message with your order number as soon as possible and we will do our best to catch it before dispatch.

items.question: Where can I see my order status?
items.answer: Open My Account → Orders to see every order with its current status. Once your parcel is dispatched you will also receive a tracking link by email.

items.question: Do you take bulk or corporate orders?
items.answer: Yes. For orders of 25 pieces or more, write to us with the styles and sizes you need and we will send a quote with a delivery date.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Orders are dispatched within one working day. Metro cities usually receive parcels in 2–4 working days, and the rest of the country in 4–7 working days.

items.question: How much does shipping cost?
items.answer: Shipping is free on orders over ₹999. Below that a flat delivery charge is added at checkout and shown before you pay.

items.question: Do you deliver outside India?
items.answer: Not yet. We currently ship within India only, and we are working on international delivery — join the newsletter to hear first.

items.question: My parcel shows as delivered but I cannot find it.
items.answer: Please check with neighbours and your building reception first. If it is still missing, contact us within 48 hours of the delivery scan and we will raise a trace with the courier.

items.question: What is your return window?
items.answer: You have seven days from delivery to start a return. Items should be unworn, unwashed and with the original tags attached.

items.question: Can I exchange for another size?
items.answer: Yes. Start an exchange from My Account → Orders and pick the size you want. If the size is unavailable we will refund the item instead.

items.question: When will I get my refund?
items.answer: Refunds are processed within 2 working days of the returned parcel reaching us. Banks usually take another 3–5 working days to show the amount.

items.question: Which items cannot be returned?
items.answer: For hygiene reasons, innerwear, socks and earrings cannot be returned. Sale items can be exchanged but not refunded.

items.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: All major credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking and popular wallets. Cash on delivery is available on selected pin codes.

items.question: Is it safe to pay on this site?
items.answer: Yes. Payments are handled by our payment partner over an encrypted connection — we never see or store your card details.

items.question: Can I get a GST invoice?
items.answer: Every order includes an invoice in your account. Add your GSTIN while placing the order and it will appear on the invoice automatically.

items.question: My payment failed but money left my account.
items.answer: Failed payments are released automatically by your bank, usually within 5–7 working days. If the amount is not back by then, share the reference number with us and we will follow it up.

items.question: How do I choose the right size?
items.answer: Each product page lists the measurements we use, and the fit notes say whether a piece runs relaxed or close to the body. If you are between sizes, size up for a relaxed fit.

items.question: Will the colours match the photos?
items.answer: We photograph every piece in daylight without heavy editing. Screens can still shift a shade slightly, so if the exact tone matters to you, ask us and we will send a real photo.

items.question: How should I care for my clothes?
items.answer: Wash cold, inside out, and dry in the shade to keep colours true. The care label inside each piece lists the specifics for that fabric.

items.question: Do you restock sold-out pieces?
items.answer: Core styles such as shirts, denim and knits are restocked regularly. Seasonal pieces are limited, so add your email on the product page to be told if it comes back.
